title: Implications of Matter--Curvature Coupled Gravity on Chandrasekhar Mass Limit of White Dwarfs
summary: We investigate white dwarfs in the framework of f(R,Lm) and f(R,Lm,T) gravity to explore the Chandrasekhar limit. We have considered two functional forms of f(R,Lm) and one functional form of f(R,Lm,T) gravity. Considering the matter Lagrangian Lm=p , we calculate modified TOV equations for each of the forms. By employing the fully degenerate electron gas equation of state in the modified ToV equations, we derive the mass-radius relation for each functional form of both f(R,Lm) and f(R,Lm,T) gravity.
